versions.changelog: Reworked demand generation to use real 2011 Census ward-level worker counts as spatial weights across all 141 KMC (pre-2012) wards, replacing the old subdistrict-level average. Fixed a coordinate-order bug in the ward boundary source (bharatlas.com/OpenCity) that stored every point as [lat, lon] instead of GeoJSON's required [lon, lat] — wards would have rendered in the wrong place without this fix. All 141 wards matched a Census weight with zero gaps.

Fixed job totals, which were being calculated from KMC's 141 municipal wards, covering only about 33% of the map's actual population. Salt Lake Sector V and New Town, both major employment hubs, were getting zero jobs regardless of total. Now using real 2011 Census worker counts across the full map area instead. Job total: 1,795,740 -> 5,099,191.

Removed ~125,900 residents incorrectly modeled on top of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport and other aviation infrastructure (covering both polygon- and line-mapped runway/taxiway features), and widened the spatial binning resolution for faster in-game loading.
